page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.6xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance featuring 24 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place the ecs.r7.6xlarge in the average tier across most standardized tests. The instance achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 1534.0 and a multi-core score of 11384.0, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 29229.28. Memory bandwidth tests recorded 129.12 GB/sec for large-block read operations and 62.93 GB/sec for large-block write operations. In LLM inference testing with a small 135M model, the server demonstrated strong text generation performance at 283.7 tokens/sec, while prompt processing for the same model averaged 1832.97 tokens/sec.

The absence of local NVMe storage requires reliance on external block storage, which may impact I/O-intensive workloads. However, the high memory density relative to compute resources provides qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound applications that do not require expensive GPU accelerators. The hardware configuration and benchmark profile make this instance appropriate for database operations, Redis caching, in-memory data processing, and enterprise web serving.
